node.title: Re^3: New meaning to SmokeTesters?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Well, [VinsWorldcom] made a good point [id://1205432|here] that there are/were actually a bunch of trademarks on things called "Perl"... apparently including [https://i.pinimg.com/originals/bc/7d/6f/bc7d6f5c0fb59bd200a2b3eca1081eff.jpg|hair nets] and "direct and mail order sales of sausages and luncheon meats" :-) (ok, at least those two are expired/abandoned)
